# R Reference Fixtures for Bundled PhosR L6 Data

This directory contains committed R reference fixtures for the bundled PhosR L6 parity path, including
downstream-analysis outputs and native-workflow reference tables.

Generate the core fixture set with:

```bash
Rscript scripts/generate_r_l6_fixtures.R
```

See [`docs/fixtures.md`](../../../docs/fixtures.md) for directory contents, trace paths, and maintenance rules.
